text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Until training, there's only... Ugh, this 
is an awkward amount of time... What 
should I do~?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, I had stuff to buy. Lemme just 
quick-click and order it real fast~!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fake lashes, toner, nail base coat... Ah~ 
I'm out of remover too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh? What gives? It's totally right. 
Resetting it... What a paaaain...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Man, it'd be such a pain to redo it 
later...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, being just a little late should 
be fine, right?! There's no way I'm going 
without lotion."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm, and done with this~! Huh? Another 
error? Ehhhh~~~!"

Tosen Jordan took much longer than 
expected, ending up skipping training 
altogether...
